description.en: Greets when the app opens, then idles and blinks now and then; reacts when tapped.
description.tr: Uygulama açılınca selam verir, sonra yerinde durur ve arada göz kırpar; dokununca tepki verir.

item.style: Pixel art, crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, limited palette, 1-pixel dark outline, flat shadow tones.

poses.name: idle
poses.motion: It stands relaxed and breathes slowly; the chest and shoulders rise and fall a little, nothing else moves, and it ends in exactly the starting pose.

poses.name: blink
poses.motion: It blinks once, calmly, and then holds exactly the starting pose.

poses.name: open_app
poses.motion: It raises one hand and waves hello once, smiles, then lowers the hand and settles into a relaxed standing pose.

poses.name: on_press
poses.motion: It does a small happy hop on the spot with a quick smile, lands softly and returns to exactly the starting pose.
